jobs.title: Autonomous Vehicle Service Technician
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

 

About the role 

The Autonomous Vehicle Service Technician  is an experienced automotive technician who carries a full workload independently.

At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it’s medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity

About the Role

The Web Growth & SEO Manager will own how prospects find and move through the FourKites website, from search and AI answers to conversion. You will combine experimentation, SEO, GEO, and AEO into one growth roadmap. You will partner with the Web Developer owning technical implementation, so your focus is strategy, content, insight, and measurable growth.

What You'll Do

Strategy and experimentation

  • Own the website strategy, roadmap, and performance across brand, product, solution, and resource pages
  • Align web priorities with demand generation, product marketing, content, and sales stakeholders
  • Own the A/B testing program: research, hypotheses, prioritization, test design, analysis, and reporting
  • Maintain a testing backlog and a library of learnings that informs design and messaging
  • Partner with the Web Platform Lead on new builds, QA, and tooling

SEO, GEO, and AEO

  • Own the SEO, GEO, and AEO strategy and roadmap

jobs.description_text:
About the role:

Health-E Commerce owns two of the largest benefit-dollar storefronts in the US, FSA Store and HSA Store, plus a growing virtual care business and a white label product line. We are hiring a Director, E-Commerce to set the strategy for those sites and own the cross-functional roadmap that delivers it.  

This is a product-led seat, not a site operations seat. The ecommerce team here is strong on execution: merchandising runs a disciplined calendar, site operations ship reliably, and the testing program has high throughput. What it needs is a leader who defines the customer problem, decides which few bets are worth making, and prioritizes the team’s workload. 

You will report to the VP of Growth Marketing and lead a team of eight across merchandising, experimentation, and site operations, with four direct reports. You will work in close partnership with engineering, paid media, lifecycle, creative, and merchandising.

As a Senior Associate on the Commercial Operations team, you will play a critical role driving the current and future state success of our team and the sales business.  In this role, help build and execute our team strategy, own team capacity planning, be the subject matter expert on our data, generate deep insights and recommendations on how to improve deal velocity and accuracy, and own the delivery of projects and programs that impact sales across all lines of businesses.

The Corporate Development team at DoorDash is a fast-paced, high-performing group responsible for sourcing, evaluating, negotiating and executing M&A and investments. We lead all aspects of identifying, evaluating, and executing transactions that have a significant impact on the overall direction of the company.
